questions.prompt: We want to visualize the output from a topic model. What’s wrong with this code?

  group_by(topic) |>
  top_n(15, beta) |>
  mutate(term = reorder_within(term, beta, topic)) |>
  ggplot(aes(term, beta, fill = as.factor(topic))) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ topic, scales = "free") +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  coord_flip()

options.text: The scales argument in facet_wrap() should be set to “free_x”.
